title: Depot — six units and four batteries

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: If that's the generator man, he's ninety minutes late and I've started making things up about his family.

nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: It's Venn.

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: Mara. Hold this a second, the thread's crossed.

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: Regulator collar. They come five to a bag and two are always the wrong pitch.

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: Six oxygen units and four batteries. That's the bay until the barge gets a slot.

nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: Four good ones?

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: Three good ones and one that lies about how full it is.

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: There's a meter on Feeder Three by the bay door. The contractor's readout says the transfer is clean. I'd like a second number from someone who's read one before.

choices.text: Who signed off on the contractor's readout?

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: Two-thirty at the terminals. It read two-thirty an hour ago as well, which is the part I don't like.

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: Tuesday. Don't do the arithmetic in front of me.

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: A man with a clipboard and a lanyard. I didn't get the name off the lanyard.

nodes.speaker: sera
nodes.text: Depot, Holt. Venn, are you on the platform?

nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: On the platform.

nodes.speaker: sera
nodes.text: Do you have the gallery diagrams? The paper set, nineteen and twenty.

nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: In a sleeve. The corners are wet.

nodes.speaker: sera
nodes.text: The corners don't matter. The valve schedule does.

nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: The map on the tablet says it's current.

nodes.speaker: sera
nodes.text: It is current.

nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: Then why do you want paper?

nodes.speaker: sera
nodes.text: It's accurate where it was updated.

nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: That isn't the same sentence.

nodes.speaker: sera
nodes.text: There's a contractor crate at stanchion four. The pulse tool is in the grey case. Take it. Holt out.

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: Ask her when the bay gets a proper feed. She'll answer that one in numbers.

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: Nobody on this platform read that report, by the way.

nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: Feeder Three. By the bay door.

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: By the bay door.
